sources.title: Sarojini Devi Road opposite Paradise — Maharaja, Happy Rooms, Kallada and Zam Zam
sources.notes: Direct opposite-side inspection shows, left to right: Maharaja Bar & Restaurant entrance sign, Kallada Travels & Logistics turquoise sign, Zam Zam black/yellow-white restaurant sign. Hotel Happy Rooms blue/yellow board is above the left part. A long pale Maharaja Restaurant & Bar band is above the Kallada/Zam Zam section; this is not treated as another operator. Upper facade is aged offwhite plaster with shallow pilasters/cornice, rectangular room windows and window AC units. Numerous utility wires and actual signal heads are visible. Precise assignment across adjacent canonical b_b5036a537e and b_b206b72b34 footprints has not been established, so no frontage geometry is authored.
